title: Document the host's backup trigger and give TermAl the status receipt
outcome: Document the host's backup trigger and give TermAl the status receipt
acceptance: docs/host-checklist.md has a section on off-host backup that tells a host to call `engram backup push` at its start, about hourly while a project has an active session and when the last session ends, that the call may be put off, what its exit codes mean, and that no retry loop is needed

The same section tells a host to read `engram backup status --json`, never to show the mode without its off-host field, to show a failed last attempt even while the mode reads backed up, and, after a restore, to give sessions identities the store has not seen
docs/features/cli-and-mcp.md documents the versioned `backup status --json` receipt field by field, and a test asserts that the documented field names are the ones the command emits
The item's notes record that the receipt schema and the checklist section were sent to TermAl's coordinator, with the mailbox sequence, and TermAl's answer

completion.summary:
The host's backup trigger and the status receipt landed as bcf4f5a on origin/master.
- docs/host-checklist.md "## Off-host backup" covers: the push trigger (start, about hourly, last session) and that a push may be put off; the exit codes, including a refusal with no report, and no retry loop; keeping a failed push's own report; the status display rules; and identities after a restore, matching the runbook.
- docs/features/cli-and-mcp.md documents the v1 `backup status --json` receipt field by field: 88 paths.
- tests/backup_status_receipt_cli.rs checks paths, listed values, JSON types and nullability against the emitted receipts.
- TermAl's qualified acceptance (Termal::Fable2 #64) is recorded. Its two requests are filed as w-837afc363f0b and w-cdad270de5e2.
- Review: the round-1 Medium is fixed; round 2 on freeze d6940bed was clean of Medium; its Lows are filed as w-70034a479cde.
- Gate test-db4ad5b4 passed. The independent evaluation passed all 4 criteria.
